text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You've been fidgeting all day today... Is 
something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
N-No, it's nothing! Nothing at all, okay!? 
Really! There's no surprise or anything!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Gah!! N-No, that's not it! It's not like 
we're planning a surprise party for 
tonight or anything like that...!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm not quite sure what it is, but it 
sounds like something fun. As long as it's 
not a worry or anything, that's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? U-Um, Suzuka-san, do you remember 
what day it is today?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
? What could it be? I don't have any races 
scheduled, though...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Jeez~! It's your birthday, Suzuka-san!! 
...Happy birthday to you-u!!
